reviews.comment: Not a great lecturer at all, but his exams were not bad. Roughly half of the exam questions came from the practice problems in the textbook, so they were easy points. If you just memorized content from his lecture slides, you can do relatively well on the rest of the test. Honestly didn't go to class and just made flashcards to study.

People who take this class dont realize that the reason you go to lecture is to learn material, and then later get tested on it. Saying lectures is a waste of time is a result of the brain damage from doom scrolling tiktok. Be honest, if you are a lazee person just take it upon yourself to drop out because you arent gonna be a doctor anyways.

Bio 112 is memorization. His lectures are straight from the textbook. To do well, I started studying a week ahead just memorizing the textbook and random fun facts. He does give around 10-20 questions from the textbook on the tests, but the tests had random questions on it. He also told no one about the extra credit. Weekly quizzes with 2 attempts.

Lectures are just what the textbook is about, and the slides are copy-pasted from the textbook. Exams are pretty irrelevant to some of the material you are learning, and one of the exams was extremely difficult. He has a good personality, but he had unorganized class structure.

BIO 112 in general is pretty hard to teach I would say. Either way reading the textbook and memorizing is basically the whole class. He can only do so much in teaching other than just showing you the material in class. He is pretty funny tho. Quizzes are 2 attempts online. Exams are hard I read/learned the textbook 2 nights before and got 70-80s.
just do not take him. his lectures were a waste of time, read the textbook, won't get an A unless you know everything by heart
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Honestly if you are a pre-med major and can actually devote time into studying, don't listen to the other reviews. Lab exams were the most diffucult part but if you understand the textbook, this class should be straightforward. Lots of exams questions verbatim to quizzes. Attendance isn't mandatory so use the time to study outside of class instead!

I don't understand the hate...exam average never below 70 but you should pass with flying colors if you fully understand and actually put time into reading/studying the textbook. For a pre-med class you don't even have to attend, he is a very good, funny prof. Lab exams were the hardest part, so put more time into those.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Do not let these negative reviews scare you! I am by no means a bio expert and I would take his class again 100%. A majority of his lectures, quizzes, and exam matieral are verbatim from the textbook. Therefore, you techincally have everything you need there to do well in the class. He is very kind and caring and truly wants to see you succeed!
not a genuine prof at all actively lies abt extra credit and exam content. u can do well in a class w a prof who doesnt want u to

His lectures are straight slides. I only ever went to the first two classes. You can read the slides and textbook and do okay on exams. Exams were pretty tricky, but he always added textbook questions to cushion.

take anyoen else this guy genuinely lies abt content splits and extra credit unless u go to class or show up for office hours and he emails u privately the correct info so he can throw off others listenign

His midterms were not the worst and passable even without studying too hard. He did include quiz questions on his tests, there were always some guaranteed points. His final was tedious and I don't know anyone who passed with flying colors. He's funny and is reachable outside of class, be aware that you'll have to put in effort to get that B\A.
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: My main issue stems from his improper communication. He changes and says things based on how hes feeling and based on what student asks him. Theres one thing to change your mind but when you say to only study 2 chapters then make that applicable to the first section, you're just wrong.

I don't understand the hate that Dr. Anieto receives. Yes, his course is very test-heavy, but also easy to do well on if you understand the textbook and have common sense. The averages were never below a 70, which is good for a pre-med course. He doesn't take attendance and posts the slides. Lab exams were the most challenging part for sure.

Only reason I did good in this class was because of SI sessions and reading the text book for myself. He records lectures but they are not of any use as all the information on the exams comes from the book. However, once I started reading the textbook in depth, the class got a lot easier. Hardly attended lectures and still did well in the class.

He was nice, but he made the class 10x harder than it needed to be because he was never clear about what information we needed to know, and when he did specify, it turned out to be false when the test came around. He reads off the slides he didn't even make himself, and I genuinely did better when I stopped going to lectures.

Lectures were not good; he rambled a lot and it was difficult to figure out what we needed to know. I taught myself from the textbook and had a very good SI. Exams were either super easy or incredibly hard. 112 is not a fun class, and Anieto didn't make it better. If you have take it, though, choose him because he is easier than other profs.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Hilarious--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Lectures weren't very helpful; he would mention minute details that would appear on the exam if you caught it. Dr. Anieto was a funny guy so I attended lecture even though it was pointless. ATTEND SI!! I only got an A because of the goat, Andy, and I read the entirety of the chapters. Be careful with other reviews, since he changes his mind A LOT!!

Contrary to many reviews, he was the best professor I had freshman year. It's a hard weed-out STEM class, so be ready to study, especially if you're pre-med. He's accessible and tells you what to expect. I rarely went to class, read the textbook, and got an A. All my friends got As because we put in the work. Study the textbooks and you'll be fine!

Do NOT take him. going to lecture was a waste of time. he would yap so much ab the most irrelevant topics and did not really teach. Exams are a hit or miss: sometimes he used verbatim txb qns... other times it seems like the qns are coming out of the clouds bc there'd be qns about info not in the txb or slides? exams arent easy. hes kinda funny tho

He's a nice guy and has a good sense of humor but lies about it what's on the exam and changes his mind at the last second without telling anyone. Did not announce any extra credit until it was past due even though I asked multiple times previously. Way too much information in lectures and not applicable to the exam questions. Labs are unrelated.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: This class was the hardest I ever had to work for an A. He is a nice and funny professor, but provides little to no help for upcoming exams, almost as if he is gatekeeping content. He is incredibly unorganized and a little strange in his grading tendencies. I would recommend SI content, as that was pretty much the only reason I did so well.

His notes came straight from the book and didn't make sense unless you read the book. Tests never matched what he said he will cover and went over very random topics in the book. Changed the layout of the final a week before and only told people that went to his office hours. Will call you out by name in class if asked for help. Won't take again.

He's not a bad prof, but he isn't great. He is a funny guy, but I stopped going to his lectures because he just read every word straight from the slides. He gave lock down browser w/ webcam quizzes, but they came straight from the textbook. His exams weren't that bad and a lot of questions came from the quizzes.
Inconsistent in his grading and the formatting of his exams and quizzes. Read slides straight from the textbook, so no need to go to lecture.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Genuinely don't understand why everyone is complaining when they have gotten high grades. Just read the text book memorize the chapter questions and study he is not that hard just people want an easy A class for bio. I never even finished all the readings and I always passed with 80-90 range on exams. Just know the topic and It's just common sense
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Extremely textbook heavy because his lecture doesn't cover all the topics. Also doesn't exactly follow his own syllabus(Made the final shorter than it was supposed to be). Doesn't give much extra credit, but if you do take his class, try to go to SI sessions or atleast look at the material in it because it does cover a large majority of the topics.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: The syllabus says very explicitly that no extra credit is offered, but then he gets mad at us at the end of the year for not doing the extra credit canvas discussions that he didn't tell us were extra credit – that should give a pretty good idea of how the class goes. All exam medians except first midterm were low 70s

Gave up going to his lectures halfway through the semester because he read straight from the slides, which were straight from the textbook. Lots of test questions straight from the textbook, but his lectures are very unhelpful. If you read you'll be fine, just not a class/teaching style I personally enjoyed.

His slides are just copies of the textbook, so read the textbook fully. He is kind of funny, but if you interact with him in any way, he will call on you in class by name. There is extra credit even though he said there wouldn't be all semester. He kept saying different information about the final too, and it wasn't clear. Wouldn't take again.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Exam composed of content never before seen. Does not teach well, I taught myself 100% of the content. Studied for hours and days on end for exams, and still the content would not match. I do not have enough space to express my existential dread surrounding this class.

Don't believe anything that's said about the exams because it's always the opposite, have to learn yourself. No extra credit but canvas discussions were extra credit. Final was confusing, said the opposite in office hours than in lecture. He can make lecture fun, will call on you in lecture so be aware at all times, especially if you emailed.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Unpleasant learning environment. Skims through slides that are summarized straight from the textbook, and will call on people in class by name for questions on the slides. Very unclear guidelines for exams, will give incorrect information about content on exam. Secret extra credit, and curves exams but will not admit. Must read entire textbook.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Lectures are entertaining, and he highly encourages participation, but attendance isn't mandatory. Tests and slide materials are completely from the textbook. Tests are very application based with a few questions from the textbook. Decent prof if you're ok with teaching yourself the material.

Anything this professor say, do not listen. He actively likes to trick or hide information about exams. Discussions that he posts, no matter what, please respond to them! He denied extra credit in the beginning of class then switched up on those. Will call on people, be prepared. One good thing is he was funny, & that's pushing it
geniunely used to love bio now i hate it. lost brain cells in class. tests are just straight textbook. the syllabus is a complete lie he doesn't follow anything on there
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Lectures not helpful. If you're the type of person able to teach yourself the material, this is the class for you! He is funny and overall nice. Test questions are sometimes so obscure that you just know you won't get it right. However, quiz and textbook questions are sometimes in test.

he's funny and an interesting guy, but if you don't want to teach yourself the entire textbook word for word DO NOT take this guy. it's hard to correct yourself if you don't go to office hours, he doesn't post past exams, answers to quizzes, nothing. If you love getting to know profs, he's for you but otherwise STAY CLEAR

He is bad at giving clear instructions, doesn't give good feedback, and switches up at the last minute on instructions/ material that will be on the exam. His tests are worded badly. The only assignments are quizzes over the chapters on a Lockdown Browser.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I NEVER went to class. Like twice. Got an A. However his exams are absolute bs you have to memorize the textbook review questions. Also he just reads off the slides during the lectures and the slides are basically just to textbook. If you read the textbook you'll be fine.

DO NOT TAKE!! He reads from the slides and explains NOTHING. The only thing good about him is that he takes questions from the textbook and puts them on the exams. My lab TA, Megan Coppeland, was the only reason I'm doing okay in the class. The textbook is a ton of reading, which I didn't have time for. hardly went to class, not worth it.

I am pretty sure I lost knowledge during his lectures. He would read directly from slides and ask questions that nobody knew as a way of teaching. The only way to learn is from the textbook and other sources. Exams were incredibly detailed and almost impossible to prepare for as he provided no resources.Would get back with my ex before taking again
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dont get me started, This guy rips his slides, lectures, and quizzes right from the book. BUT HIS TESTS, nah, some of this stuff ive never seen or heard of. Where does he want me to find this info? He is funny, but his accent makes his lectures hard to understand. Dont bother going to class, just study the book and do SI stuff.

Lectures were not helpful, would read off the slides which were straight copy and pasted from the textbook. He randomly calls on students, so be aware. This class is just a lot of info dump, but as long as you read the textbook and do the review questions at the end of chapters, you should be good. Also does extra credit without telling you...

PICK THIS PROF. He's so awesome, good lectures, funny guy that asks lots of questions, IF U PICK THIS PROF DO ANY DISCUSSIONS THAT ARE ADDED ESPECIALLY IF UNANNOUNCED AND NOT FOR A GRADE (xtra credit), not a very easy class but just study textbook and powerpoints and ur golden

Great prof. He is funny and engaging. Reads right off the slides and the slides are the EXACT info from the textbook BUT! still read the textbook itself. He is very knowledgeable and cares about his students. Go to SI's if you can, and STUDY. He will mention some specific things that will be on the exam in lecture, so I recommend going.

Lousy teacher. Tests were hard and ridiculous. And he complained about how dissatisfied he was with our grades when really he did not teach us anything that was on the test. For the entire year, he said he would not give extra credit, but on the last day complained how we didn't participate in his extra credit that he never told us about. Avoid!

He gets a lot of hate, but he isn't that bad. Not the best lecturer and he tends to ramble a lot. He likes to pick on random people mid-lecture, which can be annoying. Exams are pretty easy, and many questions are pulled directly from the (free) textbook. Online quizzes every week, with questions also taken directly from the textbook. He's funny!

You dont have to go to class, he posts the lectures online but the videos are bad and cut off. He reads off slides and goes on random tangents about random things that have nothing to do with the content. HE WILL CALL ON YOU!!!!!! No matter what. Barely any extra credit and a little hard to understand.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: He starts of the year by giving quizzes from the textbook and randomly switches up and makes it random questions. He also just reads off the slides and does not explain the new words that are on them. His exams are based off textbook questions but some of the questions are really random. He also goes on tangents and tells stories super often.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Honestly Dr.Anieto was amazing! His exams were really easy as most of the questions were pulled directly from the textbook but the 2nd exam people didn't do too good on becuase there were very little exam questions (and that unit was just overall hard). He really cares about his students and want everyone to do good but expects participation.

Only the first midterm had a median above 80, although some test q's taken from the textbook for all 3. Lectures not helpful, he reads off slides he didn't make. Very high information volume, don't expect to know what's on the test. Generally nice but there's a very obvious disconnect. Also weekly lockdown quizzes, textbook q's only

The lectures didn't help much because he reads right from his slides and speeds through them. The exams were okay, he included a lot of the questions from the textbook which helped a lot. You HAVE to read the textbook because his slides do not include much information and he uses a lot of information from the book on his exams.

Dr. Anineto loves asking questions and loves when people participate. His slides are basically the textbook. His quizzes are the textbook questions, but they are on Lockdown browser + camera. Tests are fair. Test 2 was hard. But the rest were pretty easy. He is very accessible. If you study will do fine in his class. He is very funny, btw.

Class didn't do too well for Exam 2 so he made Exam 3 so easy (50% of question pulled straight from textbook). He also reopened all missed quizzes for every student. He wants his whole class to do well, which is good but leaves an inconsistent teaching style. Taking him will be a rollercoaster, just gotta lock in fr.

This prof is amazing! His exams are so easy and he is genuinely so funny. Don't really understand these bad reviews: there's barely any outside work and lecture isn't mandatory. Not necessarily an easy A but also doesn't require TONS of commitment outside of class. Just don't go in with the expectation that it'll be a blowoff and you'll be good.

Excellent professor. If you attend lectures, you will learn a lot. He does not encourage memorization, but he wants you to understand the material so that you can answer questions that demand your reasoning more than just recall. His lectures are from his textbook, and he explains what is important. I will take him again but be ready to work hard!

Anieto is funny and kind, but not an effective lecturer. He's fine if you learn best from reading the textbook- but know it inside out. Attendance isn't mandatory- I stopped going to class after the first exam bc lectures are pointless. Tests got increasingly difficult and specific. Complicated grading system too. Overall a frustrating experience.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He actually prays on your downfall. He said the first exam was to easy, so he failed us in the next. His lectures are pointless, but attendance is optional. You basically have to memorize the WHOLE textbook word by word to do decent in his exams. He doesn't believe in extra credit and doesn't teach as the old reviews say. He's changed. AVOID HIM!
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: DO NOT TAKE ANIETO. His lectures serve no purpose because he reads straight off of slides which are direct screenshots of the textbook. If you want to do even decently on tests you must read the textbook in its entirety and even then it is atrocious. He also gives no practice materials and does not curve or give extra credit. AVOID AT ALL COSTS.

His class was only somewhat likable because he never took attendance. Going to lecture is pointless. SI taught more than he did. His slides are word for word from the textbook and during lecture he reads 2 lines and moves on. Exams are all over the place with difficulty and he doesn't give practice exams or extra resources.

DO NOT TRUST THE REVIEWS, his lectures consist of slides which he copies from the textbook, but the kicker is if you just listen to his lectures, you WILL get a 20 on any test. You basically have to read an entire textbook and know it front to back in order to do good, and they're the only grade besides THE WEBCAM + LOCKDOWN BROWSER PROBLEM SETS!
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Genuinely, you have to absorb the entire textbook of like hundreds of pages to decently score on his exams, and he literally yaps abt anything in the lectures. Biol 112 is straight memorization, but he doesn't help at all, like at least put the same info from the slides on the exams. Take anyone else...

He was really hard to understand at first, but you get used to is accent and he's literally hilarious. You do have to read like the entire textbook, but the quiz questions are from the end of every chapter in the textbook and 1/5 of his exams are the textbook questions which is so nice. He doesn't try to trick you on exams. An A is very attainable.

The lectures ain't the most helpful so you can skip and self-study. However, he is very funny (great comedy class). Exams are detailed and tedious but as long as you read textbook and ppt you are good. He silently curves exams and literally pulls word-for-word textbook review questions for 1/5th of exams. Only 2 grades: quiz & exam so free time yay

Anieto makes 112 easy; not much hw  other than a weekly quiz + lab. Exams are a bit specific at times but as long as you read the textbook and got a hang of the content, exam questions were a breeze; much less complex and stimulus-based than 111 exams in my opinion. Just take some time outside of class to read the textbook. Great prof and so funny!

Lectures are based off of slide shows in which he reads off of and provides a tad bit of extra information.  There is one quiz per chapter (12 questions straight from textbook) that's take home and lockdown. There's a total of 4 exams for lecture 2 for lab. Suggest you to read the textbook as it has a lot more info he doesn't provide in lecture.

Content is boring but prof is hilarious and kind. You don't necessarily have to memorize the textbook, but actually read it and you'll do fine on the exam; his exams and weekly quizzes are straight from the book and very doable. Overall a pretty hands-off prof but I preferred it tbh. All you need to do well in this class is the textbook!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Hilarious

reviews.comment: RUN! His exams were sooo detailed and would include the most random questions that he never covered in lecture. No extra credit or curves. Avoid him at all costs.

Dr. Anieto is a very respected and knowledgeable professor. But!! Does read off of the slides during lecture, and they're usually 40-60 slides each chapter. Labs are very interesting and fun. He is a tough grader. Exams are very detailed and textbook specific. You will always have pre-labs, post-labs, and quizzes every week.

A very knowledgeable professor who puts in a lot of work in his class. He is a tough grader but he is very fair. Lectures and Labs are very interesting and he makes sure you understand what he is talking about. Very accessible! Can be reached easily through email or actual visit. I recommend him and will gladly take his class again.

He reads right off the lectures, and the powerpoints are between 30-70 slides with so much information. His problem sets werent that bad, but both his lecture and lab exams are. The lecture exams feel too extensive and specific, and they rely on specific information from the textbook. He can also be pretty stingy with points for the labs.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Participation matters--Lecture heavy
